grader_results.detail: The bundle asks a causal question about which attention heads mediate IOI, but contains only a single logit lens analysis on one prompt—a correlational tool that says nothing about attention heads. The critique correctly identifies the core recall-relevant flaws: (1) no attention-head-level analysis at all despite the question being about heads, (2) purely correlational method for a causal question (no patching/ablation), and (3) a single prompt with no robustness or control. The proposed gaps (activation patching, attention pattern analysis, DLA, ablation, expanded prompt set, symmetric control prompts, path patching, random-head baselines) are all genuinely applicable to this bundle and none are hallucinated or trivial—the bundle truly lacks every one of these. This maps to a 5 on the rubric: every evident flaw is named with no invented or inflated gaps. Normalized to [0,1], score 5/5 = 1.0.
